## Details

The EK-Nucleus AIO CR360 Lux D-RGB is an all-in-one liquid cooling solution offering a stylish fan-like gradient lighting effect on the pump unit to suit your needs for contemporary addressable RGB aesthetics.

It is designed to fit most popular cases on the market today and features a triple fan setup with a slim 360mm radiator. Compatible with most modern processors, it is also ready for the next-gen Intel socket.

## Addressable RGB Lighting

Customize your all-in-one system to match your setup with its fully addressable RGB lighting effects. This closed-loop liquid CPU cooler offers a plug-and-play solution with a fan-like D-RGB lighting effect around the pump top for all who search for that perfect RGB AIO aesthetics.

This product is compatible with popular RGB sync technologies from all major motherboard manufacturers. The arrow marking on the 3-pin LED connector is to be aligned with the +5V marking on the addressable RGB (D-RGB) header.

## Rotatable Pump Top

The top allows you to re-orient the D-RGB EK badge no matter in which direction the cooler is installed. The orientation can be changed in 90° increments, so if the cooler is installed upside down, rotate it 180 degrees to display the logo right side up. Regardless of the angle needed to install the AIO, it will always offer clean and aligned aesthetics.

## Premium, iF Award-Winning Design

The EK-Nucleus AIO Lux is an iF Design Award winner and a true game-changer offering ultra-low temperatures for the latest Intel® 13th Gen (LGA 1700) and AMD® Ryzen™ 7000 (AM5) CPUs, backed with a 5-year warranty for total peace of mind.

Available in black and white, EK-Nucleus AIO Lux features fully customizable (addressable) D-RGB lighting, creating a tunnel light effect on the pump cover. It also comes with premium braided tubing and custom aluminum rotary fittings.

...

## Fully Customizable D-RGB Display

Your Personal Symphony of Light (or Darkness)

Customize your EK-Nucleus AIO to match your PC setup with fully addressable D-RGB lighting, offering a vast spectrum of colors, transitions, and effects easily changed with a click.

Our Nucleus AIOs are fully compatible with a range of third-party RGB software, including ASUS Aura Sync, Gigabyte RGB Fusion 2, and MSI Mystic Light, when connected via 3-Pin Addressable 5V D-RGB header to a supported motherboard.
